evidence: Labeled Wallet and touches wallet RPC and internal wallet transaction handling across 11 files.
rationale: Removes the deprecated `removeprunedfunds` RPC and internal transaction deletion logic. The PR follows up on prior deprecation in v32 to eliminate code complexity and dead deletion methods, noting 'there is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet'. While worthwhile maintenance, it is standard deprecation cleanup without an urgent deadline.
